pages.text: Pens are for combat and the field: $(cfg)4$() ml (4 doses), the bar shows what is left, the window shows the level. An empty pen is thrown away.

- Below Medicine $(cfg)4$(): you cannot pick a dose — you inject 0.75–1.25 dose at random.$(br)- Medicine $(cfg)4$()+: first a check whether it is needed (repeat within 5 s to inject anyway), then pick the dose with the wheel (step 0.1) with a hint how much is needed.
Then the injection minigame and the animation — the pen is pressed and emptied.$(br2)Pens: adrenaline, morphine, TXA, ketorolac, naloxone, diazepam, atropine, insulin.
